sources.entry: Yippy - Clipboard manager with user-friendly UI. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/mattDavo/Yippy) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Yippy - macOS open source clipboard manager

summary.one_liner: Yippy is an open-source clipboard manager for macOS, installable from a DMG or via Homebrew Cask.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Yippy as a macOS open source clipboard manager. It is installed by downloading from the project website or with `brew install --cask yippy`. The project includes Xcode schemes for production (Yippy), beta (Yippy Beta), and unit/UI tests (Yippy XCTest). A `create-installer.sh` script builds a DMG installer from a packaged app using create-dmg. The TODO list shows features that are done, including toggling attributed text, launch at login, a max history length setting, and a customizable toggle hotkey. Planned items include more pasteboard item types, automatic updates (possibly via Sparkle), favourites, and search.
use_cases: Keep a history of recently copied text on a Mac
Install a clipboard manager via Homebrew
Build a DMG installer for a macOS app
Customize a global hotkey for showing clipboard history
how_to_run: Place X.app in the same folder as create-installer.sh
notable: Attributed text toggle and max history length setting
Includes a script to build a DMG installer
caveats: Search, favourites, and automatic updates are still listed as unfinished TODO items
Supports only certain pasteboard item types for now, per the TODO list
